name: woopiai-hub
description: WoopiAI Hub - Root package for formatting and linting

scripts.format:changed: npm run format && npm run format:frontend
scripts.setup:hooks: node -e "const {execSync} = require('child_process'); const os = require('os'); const path = require('path'); const isWindows = os.platform() === 'win32'; const scriptPath = path.resolve('scripts', isWindows ? 'setup-git-hooks.ps1' : 'setup-git-hooks.sh'); execSync(isWindows ? `powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "${scriptPath}"` : `bash "${scriptPath}"`, {stdio: 'inherit', cwd: process.cwd()})"
